about: TL-MOVE-BENCH baselines for tools/check_move_bench.py. One entry per registry row; `kind` picks the extractor + tolerance SPEC in the checker; `tol` (optional) overrides a metric's tolerance. Rewrite only with `python tools/check_move_bench.py --arm <arm> --update <run-dir>` after reading the diff it prints.

ship.config: 20-order replay (5-kofu-c, tools/uiscripts/m1_moves.csv), SHIPPED configuration: libmh.dll absent, improved_movement=group_movement=improved_combat=1, every other key at its shipped default, pin_wallclock

retail.config: the same replay with the three masters 0 (retail movement), libmh.dll absent: the reference arm (tier release)

lib.config: the same replay with libmh.dll BOUND (mv_waves=0): the twins; the metrics equal the shipped arm's (tier release)

narrow16.config: the user's rc10 narrow-path orders (tools/uiscripts/saves/nortus-3.sav, tools/uiscripts/narrow16_moves.csv): 16 soldiers, six orders through the Nortus passage, SHIPPED configuration (movement presets on, every stream-heat key at its default: cost 2 below 16 mates / 32 from 16, window 120, margin 50), libmh.dll absent, pin_wallclock. Measured at M1WL v5; with cost 32 / margin 0 (the rc10 regression) the same replay shows 4 detours (order 2: 1, order 5: 3)

fc_hopwall.config: the m1h F17 hop-wall case (a 17-tile wall with a one-tile gap, 16 units re-ordered while they hop through it), shipped splice, v5 defaults: 92 tiles for the group, 13 for the worst unit (heat off: 88 / 12; cost 32 / margin 0: 117 / 22). tools/check_m1h.py F17 is red above 100 / 16, which is baseline + the allowance

stream_ship.config: the u022_stream key-1 step (45 soldiers out of one barracks to open ground ~30 tiles away), shipped splice, v5 defaults. Heat off (key 0): max/tile 42, 2 lanes

stream_lib.config: the u022_stream key-1 step with libmh BOUND (the twin); equals stream_ship

field200.config: the 200-unit field (tools/uiscripts/saves/u022field.sav, tools/uiscripts/u022_field200.txt, ids tools/data/u022_field200_ids.txt), the user's [net] keys + the v5 defaults, libmh.dll absent, state record read by tools/move_tracks.py. CHAOTIC: thresholds (abs / rel in SPEC_FIELD200), not equality. Measured at M1WL v5: heat off 1.79 exits per 100 steps, max/tile 200, 35 tiles of 100+, width 2; v4 defaults (cost 2, window 48, flat, no margin) max/tile 113, median arrival 8530; cost 32 / window 120 / flat / margin 0: max/tile 104, median/worst arrival 9175 / 12160, 143 refusals
